# Start or stop the ARM co-processor only between shots

Powering the ARM side on or off during a shot reset the camera.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Change ARM power only at an Idle or Standby state change. Keep image buffers out of ARM Linux RAM, which is reloaded at every start.

> **What happens:** Camera reset.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): On the E-M5 III both a start in a shooting state and a stop in a shot hook reset the camera; start and stop at Idle were safe. Source: [Gotchas](../sources/em5n.gotchas.md).
